result.summary: The Draft Copilot was a small local web application designed to assist users during a live Sleeper fantasy football draft. Its main goal was to serve as a tool for a 12-team, full-PPR snake draft on the Sleeper platform.

key_points.fact: The Draft Copilot was a small local web app that ran alongside a live Sleeper fantasy football draft.
The Draft Copilot was built in one session with Claude Code on September 2026.
The goal was a tool for a 12-team, full-PPR snake draft on Sleeper.
Sleeper has a public, no-login JSON API for drafts.
The companion was built as a single index.html file with rankings data embedded.

key_points.section: The Value Model > How the model evolved
key_points.fact: The first version of the model used `replacement_rank` minus `position_rank`.

key_points.section: The Value Model > How the model evolved
key_points.fact: The fix for the K/DST bug was to pin K and DST to the bottom.

key_points.section: The Value Model > How the model evolved
key_points.fact: After the blend fix, consensus rank is the main signal and scarcity only adds a 0.4-weighted nudge.
The VALUE/REACH labels were reversed by changing the operation to `pick_no` minus `rank`.
A scarcity score that overrides talent gives confident but wrong answers.
